description: Check an uploaded Word, PowerPoint, Excel or PDF file (also .doc, .ppt, .xls) for problems and fix the safe ones without touching the content, no AI: tables off the page, split signatures and broken numbering in Word; text overflowing its box or shapes off the slide in PowerPoint; formula errors, numbers stored as text or sheets too wide to print in Excel; scanned pages without text, missing title or language in PDF; amounts in words that don't match the figures in all of them. Files with macros are rejected; other dangerous content (external links and pictures, embedded files, automatic actions…) is removed. Returns the fixed file (old formats come back as .docx/.pptx/.xlsx) and what was found.

file_id.description: From upload_file, or the id of a document Doconda made (list_documents).

name: review_document
